base_prompt:
FULL-FRAME ILLUSTRATION (not a sprite): a widescreen 16:9 LANDSCAPE image, with its own complete background, no transparency. No text, no letters, no captions, no watermark, no speech bubbles.
CHARACTER (must match the attached reference exactly: face, white hair, big full white beard, black sunglasses, red Santa hat with white fur trim, comically over-muscular body, red pants with white fur cuffs, black boots, same art style: semi-realistic cel-shaded cartoon with a thick dark navy outline).
Composition: the character is centered and fills about 85 percent of the frame height (knees-up or full body), with empty space on both sides. Only ONE character. Make it dramatic and funny.
This is one frame of a 3-frame comedic intro animation: (1) he wears a tight red Santa jacket and is straining, (2) he rips the jacket off, (3) he reveals his shirtless muscles with a big grin.

jobs.name: intro_1
jobs.prompt: FRAME 1 of 3 - build-up. Here he is WEARING a bright red Santa jacket with white fur trim and buttons, stretched extremely tight over his enormous muscles (fabric wrinkles, a button about to pop). His arms are crossed tightly over his chest, both fists gripping and clutching the front of the jacket, as if holding it closed. Sweat on his forehead, clenched teeth, an intense determined expression behind the sunglasses. Dark moody background in deep purple and maroon with a single soft spotlight from above. He still wears the red pants and black boots, and the red hat.

jobs.name: intro_2
jobs.prompt: FRAME 2 of 3 - the rip. The red Santa jacket is being ripped apart from the inside: it explodes into two big torn halves flying away to the LEFT and RIGHT of the frame, with scraps of red fabric and white fur trim flying around. His arms are thrown wide open, his chest and abs are now bare, shirtless; mouth wide open shouting with fury and joy. Radial speed lines and a bright warm sunburst background in orange, red and yellow. He wears the red pants, black boots, red hat and sunglasses.

jobs.name: intro_3
jobs.prompt: FRAME 3 of 3 - the reveal. Fully SHIRTLESS (only the red hat, sunglasses, red pants with white fur cuffs, black boots). Classic front double-biceps flex, chest out, a huge confident toothy grin with a glint of light on the sunglasses. Golden sunburst background with sparkles and stars twinkling around him, triumphant and hilarious. Full body or knees-up, centered.
